info.name: SRJ AccessDB API
info.description:
FastAPI over the SRJ Access database (port 8000).

Set the collection variables first: baseUrl (default http://192.168.0.101:8000) and apiKey (the API_KEY from the server's .env). Every request sends it as the X-API-Key header.

Folders marked (new) are the read-only report routes added for CRMReports. Folders marked (careful) can write to the .mdb - their POST/PUT/DELETE bodies default to dry_run=true.

request.description: Win-back list: bought before, nothing lately. Biggest lifetime sales first.
Customers whose FIRST order is in the window.
One customer: contact, totals (orders, sales, last 12 months, open lines), recent orders with status, equipment list.
What the customer buys: qty, sales, orders, last price paid and date per item.
Order lines in a window with customer, item, rep, source, carrier, amount. basis=ordered uses order date and OrderQty; basis=shipped uses ShippingDate and OrderShippedQty. Max 800 days.

request.description: Totals per group: orders, customers, lines, qty, amount, sharePct. Date groups sorted by date, others biggest first.
12 months of this year vs last year, plus YTD to today's date for both.

Unshipped SO lines: required date, days late, status, open value, onHand and stockCover (full / partial / none, allocated by required date). Lines on orders older than stale_days are left out but counted.
Every open PO line in ONE call (replaces /api/po/all + /api/po/details per PO): supplier, item, open qty/value, due ship date, days overdue.
Dashboard tile: open SO / PO lines and values split into late, due this week, due this month, later, no date.
Suppliers with PO count, last PO date, PO value, open lines/value, containers, last container shipped.
Every line (open and closed) of POs dated in the window, header fields included.

Traceability: vendor + container for a serial / lot number, the inventory lot, and the order(s) it shipped on.

13 checks (duplicate lines, empty orders, odd dates, unknown products/customers, over-shipments, half-recorded shipments, stale open lines, duplicate customers / item codes, negative lots, PO over-shipments) with counts and examples. Reads whole tables - run it nightly, not on page load.
